scheme_name: Educational Award Scheme - Gujarat Labour Welfare Board
description:
The Educational Award Scheme is a welfare initiative launched by the Gujarat Labour Welfare Board.

This scheme was officially launched in the year 2007.

It aims to provide financial assistance to the children of registered construction workers in Gujarat.

The primary objective of the scheme is to promote education among the children of workers in the construction sector.

The scheme seeks to reduce the dropout rate among children by providing them with financial support.

The Educational Award Scheme specifically targets children who are studying in various educational institutions.

The scheme provides monetary awards based on the educational level of the child.

For students in primary education, the scheme offers an award of ₹1,000 per annum.

For students in secondary education, the award amount increases to ₹2,000 per annum.

For students pursuing higher secondary education, the award is ₹3,000 per annum.

For those enrolled in professional courses, the award amount can go up to ₹5,000 per annum.

The scheme is designed to encourage parents to keep their children in school and support their educational aspirations.

To be eligible for the Educational Award Scheme, the applicant must be a child of a registered construction worker.

The construction worker must be registered with the Gujarat Labour Welfare Board.

The age limit for children applying for the award is typically between 6 to 25 years.

The income criteria stipulate that the family income of the construction worker should not exceed ₹3 lakh per annum.

The applicant must provide proof of their parent's registration with the Labour Welfare Board.

Additionally, the child must be enrolled in an educational institution recognized by the state government.

The application process involves several specific steps.

First, the applicant must obtain the application form from the local Labour Welfare Board office.

The form can also be downloaded from the official website of the Gujarat Labour Welfare Board.

Once the form is filled out, it must be submitted along with required documents.

Required documents include a copy of the construction worker's registration certificate.

The applicant must also provide proof of age such as a birth certificate or school admission certificate.

A copy of the income certificate is also necessary to verify the family income.

The educational institution must provide a bonafide certificate confirming the child's enrollment.

The completed application must be submitted before the deadline set by the Gujarat Labour Welfare Board.

Typically, the application deadline is announced at the beginning of each academic year.

The disbursement of awards occurs annually after the applications are reviewed.

The review process usually takes about two to three months after the application deadline.

The awards are disbursed directly to the bank accounts of the beneficiaries.

The Gujarat Labour Welfare Board is the primary implementing authority for this scheme.

The Board operates under the Department of Labour and Employment, Government of Gujarat.

For any inquiries or assistance, individuals can contact the Gujarat Labour Welfare Board at their official office.

The contact details are available on the official website of the Gujarat Labour Welfare Board.

The scheme has been instrumental in increasing the literacy rate among children of construction workers.

According to reports, the scheme has benefitted over 1 lakh children since its inception.

The initiative has also contributed to a significant reduction in dropout rates among these children.

The Educational Award Scheme is part of a broader effort by the Gujarat government to enhance the welfare of workers in the unorganized sector.

The scheme aligns with the national goal of ensuring education for all children.

The government aims to create a more educated workforce in the future.

In recent years, the scheme has seen an increase in the number of beneficiaries.

This increase is attributed to greater awareness among construction workers about the benefits of the scheme.

The Gujarat Labour Welfare Board conducts regular outreach programs to inform workers about the scheme.

These programs are held in various districts across Gujarat.

The Board collaborates with local NGOs and community organizations to reach out to workers.

The Educational Award Scheme is one of several initiatives aimed at improving the socio-economic conditions of workers in Gujarat.

Other welfare schemes include health insurance and housing assistance for construction workers.

The success of the Educational Award Scheme has encouraged the government to consider expanding its scope.

There are discussions about increasing the award amounts in the coming years.

The government is also exploring the possibility of including additional educational levels in the scheme.

Overall, the Educational Award Scheme plays a crucial role in supporting the educational needs of children from economically disadvantaged backgrounds.

By providing financial assistance, the scheme empowers families to prioritize education.

This initiative not only benefits individual families but also contributes to the overall development of society.

The long-term vision of the scheme is to create a more educated and skilled workforce in Gujarat.

The government remains committed to enhancing the lives of construction workers and their families through such welfare schemes.

Continuous monitoring and evaluation of the scheme are conducted to ensure its effectiveness.

Feedback from beneficiaries is also taken into account for future improvements.

The Educational Award Scheme is a testament to the government's commitment to social welfare and education.

It reflects the importance of investing in the future of the next generation.
